HPI: weeks of symptoms relating to thickened painful nails. Patient also reports a distinct symptom requiring separate evaluation. PMH: Type 2 diabetes mellitus.

MDM: discussed risks and benefits of the planned procedure; patient consents.
Procedure: Debridement of 1 to 5 thickened nails performed with sterile technique (LT modifier documented). Tolerated well, no immediate complications.
